subject: Request: build-runner credential rotation logs & CI agent inventory
messages:
From: McGraw, Alice <mcgraw@veridian.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — CI/build agent credential rotation and inventory

Hi Jasmine,

We're working through the SIG/SOC2 evidence bundle for Veridian's assessment window and need the following artifacts to validate your ephemeral credential controls and change management for build infrastructure: 

- A roster of CI/build agents (hostnames, runner type, owner/team) active in the last 90 days.
- Token/key rotation logs for the hosted runners (showing issuance, revocation, who approved) covering 2026-05-01 through 2026-08-15.
- The PR gating policy and the recent enforcement snapshot (was there any bypass/exception in the past quarter?).
- A short note describing your change window and emergency rollback runbook for build runners.

If possible, consolidate into a single archive or provide Drive links. We aim to close this control by EOD 2026-08-27. Let me know if any of these will take longer.

Thanks,
Alice McGraw
Security Assessor — Veridian Financial
mcgraw@veridian.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.example.com>
To: McGraw, Alice <mcgraw@veridian.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — CI/build agent credential rotation and inventory

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes: 

- I attached an initial export (ci-agent-inventory-202608.xlsx) and a sampled rotation log (runner-rotation-log-2026-07.csv) so you have immediate artifacts to review. These are redacted for personal accounts.
- The PR gating policy PDF is attached (pr-gating-policy-2026-06.pdf) and includes the enforcement rules and exception workflow.
- For the change/rollback runbook, we'll provide a concise operational note and the concrete runbook excerpt.

I'm looping in Irene (head of SecOps) to collate authoritative logs (signed rotation entries) and Karthik to pull the CI orchestration audit history. We will drop a Drive folder and a JIRA ticket for tracking by EOD 8/26, with the expectation of final delivery on 8/27.

Attachments: ci-agent-inventory-202608.xlsx (metadata), runner-rotation-log-2026-07.csv (sample), pr-gating-policy-2026-06.pdf

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.example.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request — CI/build agent credential rotation and inventory

Team — forwarding Veridian's ask (see original below). Action items: 

1) Karthik: please export the CI orchestration audit stream for the period 2026-05-01 -> 2026-08-15. We need token issuance and revocation events, the approver principal, and the PR/merge IDs tied to the change. Prefer CSV with these columns: timestamp, event_type, runner_id, principal, pr/commit, reason. Mark PII as redacted. Deadline: 8/26 17:00 PT.

2) Soojin: pull the runner inventory including last_seen timestamp, owner_team, image_digest, and whether the runner uses ephemeral credentials or a long-lived service identity. Flag any runners that had bypassed PR gating in that window.

3) Irene: assemble a one-page runbook snippet describing emergency rollback for runners (steps, who approves, how to revoke tokens quickly), and confirm whether we have any outstanding exceptions. Also please sign/attest the rotation log once Karthik hands it off.

I created a temporary Drive folder for the assessor: https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/security/sdlc-evidence/2026-08-veridian — please upload artifacts there and add a small readme.md describing redactions. I'll open JIRA-SEC-4128 to track. If you hit a blocker with retention/archival data, escalate to me immediately.

Thanks — Jasmine

Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — CI/build agent credential rotation and inventory

Alice — attaching the consolidated bundle for Veridian. Summary of contents and attestations below. Please reply if you need anything expanded or additional timestamps.

Bundle contents (uploaded to Drive link): https://drive.redwood.example.com/teams/security/sdlc-evidence/2026-08-veridian
- runner-rotation-log-2026-05-01_to_2026-08-15.csv  (complete rotation events export, redacted principals)
- ci-agent-inventory-202608.xlsx  (inventory, last_seen column included)
- pr-gating-policy-2026-06.pdf  (policy + exception workflow)
- runbook-runner-emergency-rollback-2026-08.txt  (one-page runbook excerpt)
- verification-signature.txt  (Irene Choi: SecOps Lead — I attest these exports were pulled from production audit streams and redacted per policy)

Notes and clarifications:
- No long-lived runner service keys were identified for active runners in the 90-day window; flagged exceptions (two ephemeral runners manually created for a windowed load test) are documented in the exception tab of the inventory and have approval tickets (JIRA-OPS-2567, JIRA-OPS-2599).
- Rotation events include issuer and revoker principals; we redacted specific user emails per our standard PII workflow. We can provide a signed hash of the unredacted CSV if the assessor requires re-identification under NDA.
- PR gating enforcement: policy is enforced by gatebot v2.1; last bypass occurred 2026-06-13 (emergency hotfix) and is documented with reviewer rationale in JIRA-OPS-2567.

Please confirm receipt and whether Veridian needs the hashed proof or the signed attestation attached to the artifact.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Head of SecOps — Redwood Inference
Irene.Choi@redwood.example.com
Attachments: runner-rotation-log-2026-05-01_to_2026-08-15.csv, runbook-runner-emergency-rollback-2026-08.txt, verification-signature.txt
